verdict.rationale: FreeAgent's own docs show it automatically explains (categorises) new bank transactions and matches receipts and bills to transactions, and its API can pull transactions from the last uploaded statement. Together these are thin pieces of bank reconciliation, but nothing shows a per-account review that separates matched from unmatched items, and duplicate detection is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: an explicit bank-to-ledger reconciliation workflow, review of matched vs unmatched transactions, duplicate-transaction detection, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Save time with smart categorisation which automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions.
automatic data extraction, transaction matching and categorisation for receipt and bill images and files
Returns only transactions that are part of the last statement that has been uploaded.
